name: Delphinja
description: Recovers Delphi/VCL class metadata, demangles Borland symbols, and ships WARP signatures for the Delphi runtime.
longdescription:
Delphi writes its published-symbol metadata -- class names, published method and field names, message handler tables, property tables and full type information -- directly into the code section, where linear sweep disassembles it as garbage functions and the names inside it never reach analysis.

This plugin decodes those tables and applies what they carry: class structs with real field names, enumerations, published method names, a typed `Self` parameter, and message handler tables. It removes the bogus functions covering the metadata, demangles Borland symbol names, and registers WARP signature libraries built from the Delphi runtime so that statically linked RTL and VCL functions are named and typed as well.

Delphi 2 through 13 are supported; the VMT layout is detected per binary rather than assumed.
